roles.functionStatement: Quantify water quantity and movement and the uncertainty around them for supply, protection and hazard decisions.

majorDuties.duty: Characterize groundwater systems and protect drinking water sources

tasks.statement: Run an aquifer test on a supply well or wellfield to estimate transmissivity and storage from drawdown and recovery data
Delineate a wellhead or source-water protection area from hydrogeologic data and time-of-travel criteria
Review a well construction or injection well application against construction and protection standards before approval

majorDuties.duty: Plan water supply and allocation under hydrologic uncertainty

tasks.statement: Prepare a drought contingency plan with triggers, stages and response actions tied to supply indicators
Forecast water demand and supply under drought and climate scenarios for a utility or basin plan, stating assumptions and uncertainty
Compare conjunctive-use, reuse and storage options by yield, cost and reliability for an integrated resource plan

majorDuties.duty: Build, calibrate and validate predictive and simulation models of environmental systems

tasks.statement: Simulate ecosystem response to alternative land-use and climate scenarios, documenting scenario assumptions and the sensitivity of results to each.
Build a predictive model of fire risk, pest outbreak or water availability, validating it on years or areas withheld from fitting.
Forecast resource management needs from a validated predictive model, stating the horizon and interval for each estimate.

majorDuties.duty: Assess stream channel form and function in the field

tasks.statement: Survey channel cross-sections, longitudinal profile and substrate at a reach following the geomorphic assessment protocol
Identify bankfull indicators and channel evolution stage at a reach from field evidence
Classify habitat units and riparian condition along a reach to identify the processes driving channel change

majorDuties.duty: Analyze environmental data statistically and interpret the results

tasks.statement: Estimate treatment effects on ecological response variables with a method suited to the design, reporting effect sizes and intervals.
Analyze trends in a long-term monitoring dataset, accounting for changes in methods, effort and detection over the record.
Prepare statistical graphics that show the main patterns and their uncertainty for a technical or decision audience.

majorDuties.duty: Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field

tasks.statement: Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection
Screen field measurement results against applicable water-quality criteria before leaving the site, triggering resampling or notification when an exceedance appears

majorDuties.duty: Deploy, maintain and verify field sensor networks

tasks.statement: Install soil moisture, temperature and weather sensors at remote field sites, recording location, height, orientation and installation conditions.
Troubleshoot sensor malfunctions in the field with side-by-side checks against a reference instrument, recording each fault and fix.

majorDuties.duty: Develop pollutant load allocations and watershed restoration plans for impaired waters

tasks.statement: Quantify pollutant loads from point and nonpoint sources to an impaired water using monitoring data and a watershed model
Allocate a waterbody's loading capacity among point and nonpoint sources with an explicit margin of safety

majorDuties.duty: Analyze and interpret climate observations and projections for management decisions

tasks.statement: Process downscaled climate projections for a management unit, documenting the scenarios, models and downscaling method used and their known biases.
Analyze historical climate records for shifts in temperature, precipitation or extreme events, testing whether trends exceed natural variability.

majorDuties.duty: Evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence

tasks.statement: Identify which inputs drive a model's predictions with an interpretation method suited to the model, testing whether the drivers are ecologically plausible.
Explain a model's main drivers and failure conditions to managers with visuals that show what the model does and does not capture.

majorDuties.duty: Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions

tasks.statement: Quantify the dominant sources of uncertainty in an analysis, such as measurement, sampling, model and scenario, stating which result would change the recommendation.
